 style.css |  7 +++++++
 2 files changed, 15 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)

Updated the existing game in `game.js` and `style.css`:

- Actions are unlimited; you can keep taking actions without advancing the year.
- Added more life activities, including exploring, creating, volunteering, traveling, and hosting gatherings.
- Added character customization for name, pronouns, portrait, and favorite color, available again from the profile.
- Reworked the visuals into a lighter pastel palette with pinks, purples, and blues.

Assumption: unlimited actions apply to yearly activities while years still advance through **Live another year**. I verified that `game.js` passes `node --check`.
